answer: Each identity tends a trellis plot in the garden and locks a 70 credit bond. Auditors issue at most 5 credits per plot per epoch to a public inlet registry capped at 500. Weight requires retiring one credit from another plot, so none self-funds. The first credit costs 25; the k-th from one funder costs 25+5(k-1), the 1000th 5020, so 1000 fakes pay 2522500 plus 70000 bonded. An honest identity pays 25 once and recovers its bond after a clean epoch. A rented-credit ring fails because retirement is irreversible and key-bound; a self-issue ring fails because the registry rejects own-plot credits.
